title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on Numbers 12: Miriam and Aaron speaking against Moses, Yahweh's answer from the pillar of cloud, and Miriam's leprosy.

questions.text: Why did Miriam and Aaron speak against Moses?
questions.explanation: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married.

answers.text: Because he chose Joshua as his servant
Because of the Cushite woman he had married
Because he refused to share the manna
Because he gave the wagons to the Levites

questions.text: What did Miriam and Aaron ask?
questions.explanation: They said, "Has Yahweh indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn't he spoken also with us?"

answers.text: "Why did we come out of Egypt?"
"Who will give us meat to eat?"
"Who made Moses a prince over us?"
"Has Yahweh indeed spoken only with Moses?"

questions.text: How does the text describe the man Moses?
questions.explanation: Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.

questions.text: How did Yahweh come down to the door of the Tent?
questions.explanation: Yahweh came down in a pillar of cloud, stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam.

questions.text: How did Yahweh say he would make himself known to a prophet?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said that to a prophet he would make himself known in a vision and speak with him in a dream.

answers.text: In a vision and in a dream

questions.text: How did Yahweh say he speaks with Moses?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he speaks with Moses mouth to mouth, plainly and not in riddles, and Moses sees Yahweh's form.

questions.text: What happened to Miriam when the cloud departed from over the Tent?
questions.explanation: When the cloud departed, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow.

questions.text: What did Moses cry to Yahweh for Miriam?
questions.explanation: Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, "Heal her, God, I beg you!"

questions.text: For how long was Miriam shut up outside of the camp?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said she should be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people did not travel until she was brought in again.

questions.text: Where did the people encamp after they traveled from Hazeroth?
questions.explanation: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.
